title: ΕΛΠΙΣ DNS resolver database
description: Schema for dns.json. Editors such as VS Code use this to autocomplete and validate contributions.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file. Leave it as ./dns.schema.json.

//.description: Free-form comment. JSON has no comments, so this key is used instead.

version.description: Database format version. Bump only when the shape of this file changes.

updated.description: Date of the last change, YYYY-MM-DD.

regions.description: Regions offered in the Region selector. Add an entry here before referencing a new region code.

code.description: Short region code, usually the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

label.description: Human readable name shown on the button.

filters.description: Filtering profiles offered in the Filter selector.

code.description: Internal profile code, for example NSFW or SFW.

label.description: Human readable name shown on the button.

description.description: One line explaining what this profile blocks.

defaults.description: Fallback values applied to every resolver that does not override them.

dotPort.description: Default DoT port. 853 is the standard.

resolvers.description: Every resolver entry shown by the selector.

stamp.description: What the sdns:// stamp claims about this resolver. Only say true if it is true - clients act on these flags.

nolog.description: The resolver keeps no query log.

nofilter.description: The resolver blocks nothing at all. False for every filtering profile.

id.description: Unique slug for this entry, for example sg-shana-intl. Used for deep links.

region.description: Region code. Must match one of the codes in the top level regions list.

provider.description: Who runs the box. Shown in the Provider selector.

filter.description: Filtering profile code. Must match one of the codes in the top level filters list.

network.description: IP stack the resolver answers on.

feature.description: What makes this entry different from its siblings.

servers.description: Hostnames serving this entry. The site picks one at random so load stays spread out. Use hostnames only, no scheme and no path.

dohPath.description: Override the DoH path when your server does not use /dns-query.

dotPort.description: Override the DoT port when your server does not listen on 853.

maintainer.description: Who to poke when this entry breaks.

homepage.description: Link to the operator, AS page or status page.

notes.description: One or two sentences shown to the user when this entry is selected.
